high_level_description: This image is an illustration from the book "Le Petit Prince" by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. The scene depicts a young boy, known as the Little Prince, standing on a rocky outcrop with a backdrop of stars and planets. The Little Prince is dressed in a green outfit with a red bow tie and has spiky blonde hair. The text in the image reads: "HERE IS MY SECRET, A VERY SIMPLE SECRET. IT IS ONLY WITH THE HEART THAT ONE CAN SEE RIGHTLY. WHAT IS ESSENTIAL IS INVISIBLE TO THE EYE." LE PETIT PRINCE The setting appears
